# Wedding Toast

Good evening, everyone! For those who don't know me, I'm [Your Name], and I've had the privilege of being [Name]'s best friend for [X] years.

Most couples meet over candlelit dinners or in charming little coffee shops. [Name] and [Name] met on a camping trip where it rained for two straight days, the tent collapsed at midnight, and someone forgot the matches. I won't say who, but it was me.

By Saturday, we were soggy, starving, and quietly questioning every life choice. But in the middle of that chaos, I noticed something. While the rest of us complained, these two were huddled under a leaking tarp, sharing the last granola bar and laughing like it was the best night of their lives.

That's when I knew: anyone who can enjoy a disaster together is someone worth keeping.

I called that trip the worst weekend of my life. I was wrong. It was the weekend that brought two of my favorite people together.

[Name], you've always been the friend who shows up, with a spare jacket and perfect timing. [Name], you've made them happier than I ever thought possible, and I can't thank you enough for that.

So here's my wish for you both: may life bring you plenty of sunshine, but when the storms come, and they will, may you always find each other under the same tarp, laughing.

Everyone, please raise your glasses: to [Name] and [Name]!

---

This comes in at roughly 260 words. Share a few details, like names, a memory or an inside joke, and Nivana can tailor it further or trim it to exactly 250.
